name: self-awareness-coach
description: Self-Awareness Training Coach - trains self-awareness through seven-system integration (Jung/IFS/Polyvagal/ACT/Siegel/Kegan/AQAL) fused with a five-framework training core

displayDescription.en: Seven-system integration (Jung/IFS/Polyvagal/ACT/Siegel/Kegan/AQAL) fused with a five-framework training core. 16 skill cards in three families, 8-week and 21-day plans, 8 scenario clusters.
displayDescription.zh: 七大体系融合＋五框架训练内核；16张技能卡三族；8周与21天双版计划；先稳状态、再觉察、后整合。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我最近被一种情绪或内在状态困扰，想请你帮我完成首次接诊，先不要给计划。
defaultInitPrompt.en: I have been troubled by an emotion or inner state lately. Please complete the first consultation for me, and do not give a plan yet.

quickPrompts.en: I have been troubled by an emotion or inner state lately. Please complete the first consultation for me, and do not give a plan yet.
quickPrompts.zh: 我最近被一种情绪或内在状态困扰，想请你帮我完成首次接诊，先不要给计划。

quickPrompts.en: I am overwhelmed by an emotion right now. Please walk me through the five-step inner-loop (one step at a time, wait for my reply).
quickPrompts.zh: 我现在情绪很上头、内心很乱，请带我走单次扰动内循环五步（一次一步，等我回应）。

quickPrompts.en: There is a voice in my head saying I am not good enough / I keep ruminating on the same thing. Please help me do the inner work.
quickPrompts.zh: 我脑子里总有个声音说我不好／我最近反复想同一件事停不下来，请帮我做内在工作。
